Ellie (support): FYI customer Acme Retail opened an escalation: A/B dashboard shows control has ~11.7k assignments but event stream only ~1.9k. They attached screenshots and a CSV sample.
Josh (analytics): Can you paste the CSV snippet and the dashboard time window? I can run the aggregate query.
Ellie (support): Window is 2026-03-15 08:50-11:30 UTC. CSV first few rows: rollout_id=r-551, event_ts=2026-03-15T09:12Z, variant_key=control_v3, request_id=x-9a3. They say discrepancy starts ~09:12.
Nate (eng-infra): We had a consumer-group rebalance on events ingestion at 09:08-09:16 that caused a short lag on partition 4. That would delay counts but shouldn't flip variant labels.
Josh (analytics): Pulled the dashboard query. It's joining by variant_label string. Query snippet:
```
SELECT v.name AS label, COUNT(*) AS assignments
FROM rollout_events e
LEFT JOIN variants v ON v.name = e.variant_label
WHERE e.rollout_id = 'r-551'
  AND e.event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15 08:50' AND '2026-03-15 11:30'
GROUP BY v.name;
```
This is fragile if label normalization changed.
Ellie (support): We pushed label-normalizer PR #447 last week which lowercases and strips prefixes in the variants table. Could be related.
Josh (analytics): Confirmed. The customer's raw event.variant_key is "control_v3" while variants.name in the catalog was normalized to "control" by PR #447. The join collapses/misattributes to the wrong label bucket when names diverge.
Josh (analytics): Proposed immediate remediation: change dashboard query to join on canonical variant_id from ingestion (variant_id exists on both sides) and fallback to variant_key for older rows. Example:
```
SELECT COALESCE(v.variant_key, e.variant_key) AS variant_key, COUNT(*) AS assignments
FROM rollout_events e
LEFT JOIN variants v ON v.variant_id = e.variant_id
WHERE e.rollout_id = 'r-551'
  AND e.event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15 08:50' AND '2026-03-15 11:30'
GROUP BY 1;
```
data-bot: scheduled backfill job: job=bf-10211, target=analytics.rollout_aggregates, window=2026-03-15T00:00Z..2026-03-16T00:00Z
Nate (eng-infra): Backfill bf-10211 started; estimated 40m. I'll also deploy a query-layer compatibility shim that maps legacy labels to normalized forms until backfill completes.
deploy-bot: rollback triggered: analytics-service -> v2.3.0 by Josh (reason: label-join mismatch)
Oliver (sre): Added temporary monitor: metric=rollout.dashboard.assignment_delta > 0.15 for 10m -> paging on-call. Runbook: /runbooks/ab-dashboard-mismatch.
Maya (product): I'll draft the customer note and schedule a CS+PM sync. Ellie, please share the interim event counts and ETA.
Ellie (support): Sent interim numbers and ETA (~40m for backfill). Customer acknowledged and asked for written RCA and fix plan.
Josh (analytics): Root cause (draft): dashboards joined on human-facing label strings that were normalized in a recent change (PR #447). Historical events still reference pre-normalization keys, so joins misattributed assignments. Contributing factors: missing test coverage for label normalization changes and dashboards relying on mutable display fields. Actions: 1) migrate dashboard queries to join on variant_id, 2) finish backfill bf-10211, 3) keep query shim for 24h, 4) add integration tests, 5) add an alert for >15% delta between dashboard and raw-event aggregations.
Ellie (support): Customer updated: counts started shifting ~30-50m after we kicked off backfill; they see alignment now. They're asking for a postmortem and permanent mitigation.
Maya (product): Add a migration checklist item: any change to variant labeling must include analytics compatibility plan and a 48-hour monitoring window.
Josh (analytics): Opening ticket TKT-7810 to rework all rollout dashboards and add tests.
Nate (eng-infra): I'll follow up to see if we can avoid rebalance-related ingestion blips during backfills; separate item.
Ellie (support): Closing loop with customer and sending RCA doc + offer for a 1:1 review. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
